# Card

An overview card: what an area of the page is about, one sentence on why it matters, and a link to the full list, with the page's own content as the body.

## Usage

```html
<r-card heading="Invoices" lead="Three are past their due date." icon="file"
        link-text="All invoices" href="/invoices" tone="warn">
    <select slot="action">
        <option>This month</option>
        <option>This year</option>
    </select>
    <ul>
        <li>…</li>
    </ul>
</r-card>
```

The card puts a heading row before its existing children, which stay as the body. Moving the card in the DOM never adds a second heading row.

### A Heading with Markup

```html
<r-card level="3" link-text="All findings" href="/findings">
    <span slot="heading">Findings <r-badge count="0" tone="ok" show-zero></r-badge></span>
    <r-badge slot="action" count="4" tone="warn"></r-badge>
    <button slot="action" type="button">Rescan</button>
    <ul>…</ul>
</r-card>
```

A direct child with `slot="heading"` becomes the heading in place of the `heading` text, and needs no `heading` attribute. Every direct child with `slot="action"` moves into the heading row, in order, so a count and a button can sit there together.

### The Body

The body is the card's own children, not a wrapper: the card never moves the page's content into an element of its own, so the page's selectors on it keep working. To give the body padding or a background of its own, wrap it in an element of yours:

```html
<r-card heading="Invoices">
    <div class="invoice-list">…</div>
</r-card>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `heading` | `string` | The card's heading text. A card with neither `heading` nor a `heading` slot reports an error and leaves out the heading row. |
| `level` | `1` – `6` | The heading element, `h1` to `h6`; `h2` by default. Pick the level that fits the page's outline; the size stays `--card-heading-size` whatever the level. Any other value reports an error and the card uses `h2`. |
| `lead` | `string` | One sentence under the heading; left out when empty or missing |
| `icon` | `string` | An [icon](../foundations/Icon.md) name shown in the heading row; left out when empty or missing |
| `link-text` | `string` | Text of a link with an arrow icon in the heading row; the link is left out when empty or missing |
| `href` | `string` | Where the link goes. A `link-text` without `href` reports an error and leaves the link out. |
| `tone` | `ok \| info \| warn \| danger \| muted` | The card's accent, through `--tone` and `--tone-soft`. A card with a tone and no `icon` shows the tone's icon. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
|------|-------------|
| *(default)* | The card's body: every child not marked for another slot |
| `heading` | A direct child whose content is the heading, such as a span holding a badge. Wins over the `heading` attribute. |
| `action` | Every direct child with `slot="action"`, such as a count, a select or a button, is moved into the heading row in order. An element marked deeper down stays where it is. |

## Parts

| Selector | What it is |
|----------|------------|
| `.card-head` | The heading row: icon, `hgroup`, actions and link |
| `.card-head hgroup` | The heading (`h2` unless `level` says otherwise) and the lead paragraph |
| `.card-head a` | The link to the full list |

## Variables

The card takes `--card-radius`, `--card-padding`, `--card-gap` and `--card-border`, and its accent from `--tone` and `--tone-soft`. Its heading is `--card-heading-size`; set it lower for a compact card:

```css
.home-page r-card {
    --card-heading-size: 1rem;
    --card-padding: var(--space-2);
}
```
